name: Zodiac Style Plugin
description: A views style plugin using Zodiac.
project_description:
This module provides a Views style plugin for Zodiac — a dependency-free carousel written in TypeScript. It renders a view's rows as a responsive slider and handles per-breakpoint options using standard media queries, making it a seamless fit with Drupal's breakpoint system.

Configuration (set per view in the Views UI, no settings page): Autoplay, Autoplay Speed, Enable Live Region, Gap, Infinite Scrolling, Items Per View, Live Region Text, Pause On Hover, Transition Speed, and Use Breakpoint Group (customize a subset of settings per screen size).

Setup: after enabling the module, edit or create a View, in the Format section select the Zodiac style, then configure the style settings; the Use Breakpoint Group option enables per-breakpoint overrides.
